desc:
⚠️ Deadly Lab Tests 💀

Welcome, Test Subject. Your safety is our second priority. 🧪

Explore a facility full of test bays. Every bay holds a machine that does something unique to whoever's inside.

Step in and push the button, or use the console out front to send a friend in instead. 😈

Turn a console below LETHAL to mutate instead of dying. Mutations stack, so mix them and see what you turn into. 🧬

- Wild death effects
- Prank your friends
- Unlock every test and find all the mutations
- A facility announcer who comments on every test

PRESS THE BUTTON 🔴
